FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMICS, PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH
D-Eco/26/87
Dated: 22.01.2026
NOTICE
Applications are invited for 01 post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) in Statistics to teach Under
Graduate Minor course* under NEP as per allotment for the semester started from January, 2026 to be
filled through prescribed form. The tentative workload of the selected guest faculty would be as
follows:
Days of teaching Classes to be taught Subject to be taught
Monday to Friday U.G. Statistics Minor under NEP*
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with an
upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month as per Panjab University rules. Similarly the guest faculty will
have to be present in the department from 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. The candidate shall have to give an
undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any
agency till they are teaching in Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh as a Guest
Faculty.
Essential Qualifications as per clause 4.4.1 of UGC Regulations-2010:
i. Good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least
55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically and Visually Handicapped) or an
equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the
Master’s degree in Statistics from an Indian University or an equivalent
degree from an accredited foreign University.
ii. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate should have either
cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC; CSIR or
should have obtained Ph.D. Degree in relevant subject.
How to Apply:
The candidates are required to submit one hard copy of duly filled form along with copies of
two sets of attested certificates and other supporting documents to the office of the
Chairperson, Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh latest by
03rd February, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. The candidates are also required to send the soft copy of
the same at ecochairperson@pu.ac.in . Late applications will not be considered and will stand
rejected.
i. No separate interview letter shall be sent.
ii. All applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant
documents for verification at the time of the interview.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf).
No TA/DA will be paid for the same
*The syllabus is available at https://puchd.ac.in/includes/syllabus/2025/20250723123327-
b.scstatisticssemester1to62025-2.pdf?2026
Sd/-
Chairperson
Department of Economics
Panjab University, Chandigarh
